name: Janseva Pratishthan Foundation
missionStatement: Dedicated to empowering communities, transforming lives, and fostering lasting change through compassion, service, and collective action.
coreBelief: Inequality Is Not Inevitable, It Can Be Changed.

founder.name: Shabbir Shaikh
founder.quote: True transformation begins at the grassroots, where compassion meets decisive action. Through our six pillars—Sports, Healthcare, Social Justice & Welfare, Anti-Cyber Crime, Anti-Drugs De-Addiction, and Youth Empowerment—we strive to build an equitable society where every young person is shielded, skilled, and empowered to lead with dignity.
founder.hindiQuote: सच्चा सामाजिक बदलाव ज़मीनी स्तर से शुरू होता है—जब हम खेलकूद, स्वास्थ्य, सामाजिक न्याय, साइबर सुरक्षा, नशा मुक्ति और युवा सशक्तिकरण के ज़रिए हर युवा को सुरक्षा, स्वाभिमान और उज्ज्वल भविष्य प्रदान करते हैं।
founder.visionSummary: Founded to bridge societal gaps from the grassroots level, Janseva Pratishthan Foundation channels empathy into actionable, transparent, and scalable interventions across its six core pillars.

generalSecretary.name: Deepak Parki
generalSecretary.background: Executive Administration, Strategic Operations & Grassroots Mobilization
generalSecretary.quote: True leadership in social service is measured by transparency in governance and unwavering consistency on the ground. At Janseva Pratishthan Foundation, our administrative machinery is driven by a single commitment: ensuring every intervention—be it putting a digital laptop in the hands of a meritorious student, delivering urgent medical aid, or steering youth away from drugs—is executed with complete integrity, auditability, and speed. Our doors are always open to volunteers, partners, and citizens who believe that lasting transformation happens when administrative rigor meets genuine human empathy.
generalSecretary.hindiQuote: सामाजिक सेवा में नेतृत्व का असली पैमाना ज़मीनी पारदर्शिता और निष्ठा है। जनसेवा प्रतिष्ठान में हमारा संकल्प है कि हर राहत और सशक्तिकरण अंतिम व्यक्ति तक बिना किसी देरी और पूरी ईमानदारी से पहुंचे।
